briefing.note: panel_mission carries its own disableAfterDelay: disableDelay 3.8, enabled, targeting itself, at JumpSeat_Photon.prefab:45182 and :48673, mechanism in disableAfterDelay.cs:8-16. disableDelay is a public float with NO initialiser, so 3.8 is shipped behaviour and not a code default. A panel live at spawn (see liveAtSpawn above) is therefore killed 3.8 s after spawn; one that is not does not start its countdown until something activates it, because Start() does not run on an inactive GameObject. What activates it, if anything, is NOT traced here. There is no second hide on this vehicle -- the JumpSeat HUD is HUD_Gameplay, which has no HideMissionUI. Ends in a newline, which is in the shipped bytes.
